import pandas as pd


def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    payments = inputs["payments"].copy()

    n = len(payments)
    reason_code = pd.Series([None] * n, index=payments.index, dtype="object")

    amount = payments["amount"]
    currency = payments["currency"]
    country = payments["country"]

    allowed_ccy = {"USD", "EUR", "GBP"}

    r1 = amount.isna()
    r2 = (~r1) & (amount <= 0)
    r3 = (~r1) & (~r2) & (~currency.isin(allowed_ccy))
    r4 = (~r1) & (~r2) & (~r3) & (country.isna())

    reason_code = reason_code.mask(r1, "AMT_NULL")
    reason_code = reason_code.mask(r2, "AMT_NONPOS")
    reason_code = reason_code.mask(r3, "CCY_INVALID")
    reason_code = reason_code.mask(r4, "CTRY_NULL")

    is_rejected = reason_code.notna()

    clean = payments.loc[~is_rejected].copy()
    clean["amount"] = clean["amount"].round(2)

    rejects = payments.loc[is_rejected].copy()
    rejects["reason_code"] = reason_code.loc[is_rejected]

    return {
        "payments_clean": clean.reset_index(drop=True),
        "payments_rejects": rejects.reset_index(drop=True),
    }
